# Draft:Warrior Ascent Promotions

----
Warrior Ascent Promotions is a South African professional boxing promotion company based in Johannesburg. The company was founded by sports promoter and former professional footballer Brad Dayan Norman.
The promotion company focuses on developing professional boxing talent and promoting boxing events featuring fighters from across Africa and internationally.
History
Warrior Ascent Promotions was established by Brad Dayan Norman after his career as a professional footballer. The organization was created with the aim of promoting boxing talent from Africa and providing opportunities for fighters from disadvantaged communities to compete on international platforms.
The promotion company has promoted numerous professional boxing events in South Africa and internationally, showcasing fighters from countries including South Africa, Argentina, Malawi, Nigeria, Zimbabwe and the Democratic Republic of Congo.
Several of its events have been streamed globally and have featured title fights sanctioned by international boxing organizations.
Fighters
Warrior Ascent Promotions manages and promotes professional fighters from multiple countries and has worked with more than sixteen boxers including both male and female athletes.
Events
The promotion company has staged multiple professional boxing events in South Africa featuring regional and international fighters.
Partnerships
Warrior Ascent Promotions has collaborated with organizations including the World Boxing Council (WBC) and other boxing bodies.
